title: Foundation Cycle
schedule: Fri - Day 4 - Posterior chain + full body
intro: Foundation Cycle: an 8-week base-building cycle. Four training days, one optional easy day. Push / pull / legs plus a posterior-chain day, so every muscle group gets one focused session a week and enough recovery.

Progression is double progression: week 1 do 3 sets of 10 on the main pair, week 2 3 x 12 with the same load, week 3 add a set (4 x 10) and a little load, week 4 4 x 12. Weeks 5-8 repeat that pattern with new exercises.

Each day: a main superset (A1/A2) that follows the progression, then a tri-set (B) with fixed reps for pump and control, then a conditioning piece that gets one round or a few minutes longer each week.
Tempo: 4 digits. 1st = lowering (seconds), 2nd = pause at the bottom, 3rd = lifting (X = explode), 4th = pause at the top. Example 3010.
Load: pick weights where the last 2 reps of every set are hard but clean. If you hit the top of the reps on all sets with good tempo, add a small amount next time.
Week 9: deload (half the sets, no conditioning), then move on to the Contrast Cycle or the Power Cycle.
